data_processing: A cDNA library constructed by technology from the pooled RNA from midbrain samples of mouse was sequenced run with Illumina sequence platform. Prior to assembly, the low quality reads(1,reads containing sequencing adaptors; 2,reads containing sequencing primer;3, nucleotide with q quality score lower than 20) were removed.,We aligned reads of samples to the UCSC (http://genome.ucsc.edu/) C57BL_6NJ mouse reference genome using HISAT package.,The mapped reads of each sample were assembled using StringTie. Then, all transcriptomes from Samples were merged to reconstruct a comprehensive transcriptome using perl scripts. After the final transcriptome was generated, StringTie and edgeR was used to estimate the expression levels of all transcripts. StringTie was used to perform expression level for mRNAs by calculating FPKM.,The differentially expressed mRNAs were selected with |log2foldchange| 鈮 1 and p value < 0.05 by R package,Assembly: mm9,Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include RPKM values for each Sample and each gene

stop_claims.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: every sequenced sample is a sedentary mouse given vehicle, MPTP and/or injected recombinant irisin (GEO treatment field; S2.5.p1). Exercise exists only in the human serum cohort (S2.1.p1), which has no transcriptome. Irisin injection is not exercise; an irisin-vs-vehicle contrast would answer a different (pharmacological) estimand.
